main_concerns.concern: 主 AI 把“获取/证明真实外部长期项目样本”这一难题，降级为“写一个生成器，在源码仓库外生成样本并立即自我校验通过”。这是典型的“生成证据即完成”式自循环，可能用夹具冒充真实项目成熟度。

task_id=fixture-task semantically labels the sample as a test fixture. A real external project has meaningful identifiers from its own domain (issue numbers, task keys, project slugs), not a name that announces its manufactured nature. The real-sample-generate command proves the generator works, but does not prove Loom can discover, connect to, and validate a real external project that RedCap did not itself generate.

minimum_fixes.minimum_fix: 在关闭 LS-006 前：1) 公开审查完整样本清单和会话清单；2) 若样本确为生成夹具，则不应标记为 closed_external_sample_verified，而应改为更诚实的分类（如 closed_generated_external_sample_verified）或保持开放，并更新合约区分“生成样本”与“真实长期外部项目样本”；3) 验证 task_id 在样本清单、会话清单、校验命令中一致且与 LS-006 任务关联。

Decouple the fixture from real external verification. Either: (a) Replace fixture-task with a real external project identifier — one that exists independently of the RedCap repo and generator output, and existed before the real-sample-check run; or (b) Roll back LS-006 status to open_solution_designed_no_fix with an honest note: "Generator verified (generate+check loop works against self-produced samples), but not yet proven against real external projects." In either case, rename fixture-task to something that indicates it is a generated fixture (e.g., generated-loom-sample-task) so that its artificial nature is immediately apparent to anyone reading the identifier in any context.
